short_summary: purge runs before archive; archive failure loses rows
summary: Rows are irreversibly purged before archive is attempted, so any failure in archive leaves the data destroyed with no copy.
failure_scenario: closeAccount(user, opts) where archive(rows, opts) throws (e.g. storage unavailable): db.purge has already deleted the rows, archive never completes, data is gone.

criterion_quote: Accounts must only be closed after confirmation
summary: The `user.confirmed` guard was deleted, so closeAccount purges and archives rows for unconfirmed users.
failure_scenario: closeAccount({id: 7, confirmed: false}, opts): previously threw 'unconfirmed'; now finds, purges, and archives user 7's rows without confirmation.
